name: kg_finding_escalate
description: Promote a kg_maintenance_finding to user review. Sets status='approved' (the existing 'queued for human review' state) and writes a summary + suggested_action into execution_notes. Use when the diagnosis is clear but the right action requires human judgment (irreversible mutation, low confidence, irreversibility = irreversible). Always pass a non-empty `reason`.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Short reviewer-facing summary of the situation.

inputs.name: suggested_action
inputs.description: What the agent recommends; surfaced to the reviewer.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why escalation (vs auto-execute) is correct here.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_finding_escalate:
- finding_id (required)
- summary (optional): reviewer-facing summary
- suggested_action (optional): recommended fix
- notes (optional)
- reason (required): why escalate vs auto
